## Summary

Describe the user-facing problem first, then the behavior this change produces. If the change is documentation-only, name the reader decision it makes easier.

## Scope

- [ ] The change is limited to the stated problem.
- [ ] Generated references, source coverage, or release contents are updated when needed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private manuscript text, or unrelated files are included.
- [ ] Upstream Phrasebank text and attribution are preserved unless the generator/source contract changed.

## Validation

- [ ] Standard skill validator
- [ ] Project validator
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Release archive checks, when release contents changed

Record the commands that were actually run and summarize any skipped check with a reason.

## Compatibility

Describe any change to installation paths, skill invocation, reference routing, supported hosts, or release contents. Write `None` when compatibility is unchanged.
